related_questions.question: Can you sleep in the same bed with someone who has COVID?
related_questions.snippet: Someone in isolation should: Sleep in a bedroom not used by anyone else. If that's not possible, try to keep as much of a distance as possible between beds. If sharing a bed, even sleeping head to toe can help. Use a separate bathroom, if possible.

related_questions.question: What to do immediately after being exposed to someone with COVID?
related_questions.title: Take Precautions Right Away
list: Start wearing a high-quality mask or respirator (such as N95) as soon as you find out you were exposed to someone with COVID-19.
You should wear a mask any time you are around others either inside your home or around other people in public.
Start counting from day 1 of exposure.
